The '''DA-5''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] produced by [[Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation/Legends|Desler]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
